kind.setup: Set up the local model server

noAction: No action needed: you can keep working, this continues in the background.
checkServerHint: Checks that the server answers and which hardware it uses. Nodestro never starts, stops or changes this server.
resumed: Continued: {{size}} were already there from an earlier attempt.
stalled: No new data for {{time}}. The connection may be interrupted; the download retries on its own for a while.

done.setup: The local model server is ready.

setup.check: Check this system and what is installed

notes.bundled: Part of this app, nothing to install.
notes.missing: Not installed yet: Nodestro installs the pinned version.
notes.external_found: Not installed yet. An Ollama of your own runs on this computer; Nodestro leaves it alone and runs its own server next to it.
notes.archive: Installed from the release archive you chose.
notes.container: Nodestro Local Docker provides the server in its own container.
notes.external: Your own server: Nodestro only uses it.
notes.not_managed: Not done by Nodestro for this server.
notes.autostart_off: Not started: the server does not start with the application.
notes.version_differs: The server reports a different version than the one Nodestro installs.
notes.gpu_nvidia: NVIDIA graphics card found: models run on the GPU.
notes.gpu_apple: Apple silicon: models use its GPU.
notes.gpu_none: No supported graphics card: models run on the CPU (slower).
notes.remote: The server runs on another computer: its hardware is not known here.
notes.not_here: The model folder of this server is not on this computer.
notes.ready: Agents can use local models now.

remedy.network: Check the internet connection (and the proxy, if you use one), then try again. A download continues where it stopped.
remedy.disk_full: Free up space on that drive or choose another model folder under Model folder, then try again.
remedy.cancelledResume: Continue to resume: what was downloaded so far is kept.
remedy.cancelled: Start it again when you need it.
remedy.interrupted: Continue to resume: a download continues where it stopped.
remedy.unreachable: Check that the server runs and that its address is right, then try again.
remedy.timeout: The server is busy or slow. Wait a moment, then try again.
remedy.start_failed: Look at the server log named in the technical details. Restarting the computer frees a blocked port or memory.
remedy.checksum_mismatch: The file was removed. Try again: it is downloaded anew.
remedy.offline_download: The strict offline mode is on. Install from a release archive on this computer, or switch the mode off.
remedy.unsupported_platform: Run your own Ollama and enter its address for the Ollama provider under AI providers.
remedy.models_dir: Choose a folder you can write to under Model folder.
remedy.model_missing: Check the model name. Only models of the Ollama library can be downloaded.
remedy.install_running: Another Nodestro window is installing already. Wait until it has finished.
remedy.port_in_use: Another program uses the port. Restart Nodestro.
remedy.unsafe_archive: Use the original release archive of the pinned version.
remedy.generic: Look at the technical details, then try again.
